note: Brew Studio's deliverable library. Every style says which Higgsfield job makes it (data/higgsfield-routes.json), the look it asks for, whether real type goes over it, and the cards it suits. The 'ads' group is Higgsfield's own designed ad styles (data/higgsfield-styles.json, preset_id), loaded at run time. Carousel-type boards (carousels, stories sets, marketplace listings, product page sets, photoshoots) take a SET: one style per slide, made into one board.

styles.label: Closeup
styles.look: A tight, joyful closeup: a person holds the product near their face, bright clean light, a plain soft background, the product label facing camera.

styles.label: Hands only
styles.look: Only hands holding or using the product, no face, natural daylight, a clean real surface.

styles.label: Full body
styles.look: A full-body lifestyle photo of a person using or wearing the product in a real home, candid and relaxed.

styles.label: Editorial
styles.look: A magazine editorial photograph: styled, confident, a strong single light, a simple coloured backdrop, the product held proudly.

styles.label: UGC
styles.look: A casual phone photo a real customer would post: everyday room, natural window light, slightly imperfect framing, the product in use.

styles.label: In use
styles.look: The product doing its job in the exact moment it matters, in the place it's used.

styles.label: Studio white
styles.look: A premium studio packshot on seamless white, soft even light, a gentle contact shadow, the whole product sharp.

styles.label: Color pop
styles.look: The product on a bold single-colour backdrop in the brand's colour, hard light, a crisp shadow, playful and graphic.

styles.label: Natural
styles.look: The product outdoors in natural light on stone, wood or sand, with real depth and texture.

styles.label: Flat lay
styles.look: An overhead flat lay of the product with a few props that tell its story, on a soft textured surface, morning light.

styles.label: Gift moment
styles.look: The product being unwrapped or given as a gift, tissue paper, warm light, hands only.

styles.label: On model
styles.look: A model wearing or using the product, a clean simple backdrop, the product fully visible and true to size, fashion e-commerce light.

styles.label: Meme / native
styles.look: A casual, slightly imperfect phone photo that looks like an organic post in the feed, a real everyday moment with the product, nothing polished.

styles.label: Main image (white)
styles.look: The marketplace main image: the real product cut out of its own photo, alone on pure white (#FFFFFF), filling 85% of the frame, no props, no text. Nothing is redrawn.

styles.label: Lifestyle
styles.look: A marketplace lifestyle image: the product in real use, bright and clear.

styles.label: Benefits
styles.look: A clean marketplace infographic: the real product on the right, three short benefit callouts with simple icons on the left, white background.

styles.label: Size guide
styles.look: A marketplace scale image: the real product on white held in a hand so its true size reads at a glance; no measurements or numbers unless they are given.

styles.label: Offer card
styles.look: A bold offer poster in the brand's colours with the offer as the hero type.

styles.label: Review card
styles.look: A clean card with one real customer review in large type and five stars.

styles.label: Illustration
styles.look: A flat brand illustration in the brand's colours.

styles.label: A+ header
styles.look: An Amazon A+ header banner, 970×600: the real product large on one side, the brand's name and its one-line promise in clean type on the other, in the brand colours. No prices, ratings, reviews, '#1' or 'best', no shipping, guarantees or time-limited offers (Amazon's A+ rules).

styles.label: A+ in use
styles.look: A square A+ tile: the product in real use, bright and clear, no text.

styles.label: A+ detail
styles.look: A square A+ tile: a close-up of the product's texture or its key detail, no text.

styles.label: A+ in the hand
styles.look: A square A+ tile: the product held in a hand so its true size reads at a glance, no text.

styles.label: A+ wide
styles.look: A wide A+ banner, 970×300: the product in its real setting, calm space on one side, no text.

styles.label: Review
styles.look: A real customer talks to their phone camera about why they love the product, holding it up, natural home light, honest and warm.

styles.label: At home
styles.look: Someone at home uses the product in their routine, talking casually to camera.

styles.label: Unboxing
styles.look: Someone opens the delivery box and reacts to the product, phone filmed, real excitement.

styles.label: Shopping
styles.look: Someone shows the product they just bought, walking and talking to camera.

styles.label: How to
styles.look: Someone shows how to use the product step by step, talking to camera.

styles.label: Try-on
styles.look: Someone tries the product on in front of a mirror and reacts, phone filmed.

styles.label: GIF loop
styles.look: A seamless loop: one gentle, continuous motion around the product that ends exactly where it starts, plain calm background, no text.

styles.label: Hypermotion
styles.look: A fast, energetic camera move around the product with dynamic light streaks; the product stays exactly as it is.

styles.label: Product showcase
styles.look: A slow, premium turn around the product on a plinth, soft moving light, dark elegant backdrop.

styles.label: Color pop
styles.look: The product on a bold colour backdrop with playful bounces and a crisp shadow.

styles.label: In life
styles.look: Gentle natural motion in a real setting where the product is used: steam, light, fabric moving.

styles.label: Dark minimal
styles.look: A minimal dark scene, a single moving light reveals the product.

styles.label: 360° turn
styles.look: The product turns a full slow 360 degrees on a turntable, even studio light, a clean plain backdrop; every side of the product stays exactly as it is.

styles.label: Texture / ASMR
styles.look: An extreme macro close-up of the product's texture and surface in slow motion, soft raking light, tactile and calm.

styles.label: Unveil
styles.look: A soft fabric or shadow slides away to reveal the product, slow and premium, one moving light.

styles.label: Recreate it
styles.look: The reference video kept as it is (its moves, its people, its timing), with our product in place of theirs, exactly as in our photos. No other brand's name, logo or product is left in it.

styles.label: Viral short (30 s)
styles.look: A fast multi-shot vertical short: a hook in the first second, the product in real use, one clear reason to buy, and an ending that loops back to the start. Natural light, real people, no on-screen text.

styles.label: Hook + demo
styles.look: A TikTok: a strong first-second hook to camera, then a quick demo of the product, vertical, fast cuts, natural sound.

styles.label: POV
styles.look: A POV TikTok showing the product in a relatable moment, phone filmed, natural sound.
